title: Hiring a car
instructions: Mr Silva tatilde araba kiralıyor. Uzun bir diyalog; süre, araba türü, fiyat ve kurallara dikkat et.

script.speaker: staff
script.text: Good morning. How can I help you?

script.speaker: silva
script.text: I'd like to hire a car for five days, please.

script.speaker: staff
script.text: Certainly. What kind of car would you like?

script.speaker: silva
script.text: Something small and cheap. It's just me and my wife.

script.speaker: staff
script.text: We have a small car for thirty-five euros a day, or a bigger one for fifty.

script.speaker: silva
script.text: The small one is fine. Is insurance included?

script.speaker: staff
script.text: Basic insurance is included. Full insurance is ten euros more per day.

script.speaker: silva
script.text: I'll take the full insurance. The roads here are narrow!

script.speaker: staff
script.text: Good idea. Please bring the car back with a full tank of petrol.

script.speaker: silva
script.text: Of course. Where can I leave it at the end?

script.speaker: staff
script.text: You can leave it here or at the airport. The airport costs twenty euros extra.

script.speaker: silva
script.text: We're flying home from the airport, so I'll leave it there.

script.speaker: staff
script.text: No problem. Can I see your driving licence and credit card?

questions.prompt: How long does Mr Silva want the car?
questions.evidence: I'd like to hire a car for five days, please.

questions.prompt: How much is the small car per day?
questions.feedback: Küçük araba günlük otuz beş euro; büyük olan elli.
questions.evidence: We have a small car for thirty-five euros a day

questions.prompt: Why does he take full insurance?
questions.feedback: Yollar dar olduğu için tam sigorta alıyor.

questions.prompt: Where will he leave the car?
questions.feedback: Eve havalimanından uçacakları için arabayı havalimanına bırakacak (yirmi euro ekstra).
